findings.fix: Drop `[Q.IsPrime]` from `AlgHom.IsArithFrobAt.apply_sqrt` (line 68) and `IsArithFrobAt.smul_sqrt` (line 148), then from `TauCeti.NumberField.isArithFrobAt_apply_sqrt` (NumberField/Frobenius.lean:80) and `isArithFrobAt_multiquadratic_eq_one_iff` (Multiquadratic/Frobenius.lean:64), whose proofs only forward to it. findings.issue: `[Q.IsPrime]` is unused in `AlgHom.IsArithFrobAt.apply_sqrt`. The proof uses only ideal operations (`Q.mul_mem_right`, `Q.add_mem`, `Q.neg_mem`), `natCard_quotient_under` (which declares only `[Q.LiesOver ...]`), and `mul_eq_zero` — i.e. `IsDomain S`, not primality of `Q`. In `hsep` the primality invoked is `hpint : Prime (p : ℤ)`, not `Q`. The same unused instance is threaded through three downstream declarations, so callers must produce a `Q.IsPrime` instance to compute a Frobenius image on a square root.

findings.issue: The `hgal`/`hact` block (Galois action on `𝓞 K` is compatible with `algebraMap (𝓞 K) K`) is proved inline here and again verbatim at MultiquadraticSplitting.lean:130-137, both via `galRestrict`/`algebraMap_galRestrict_apply`/`integralClosure.coe_smul`. This is one general fact duplicated, in a PR that already extracts three other shared helpers (`integralSqrt`, `algEquiv_eq_one_of_adjoin_eq_top`, `algebraMap_int_mem_iff_dvd_of_liesOver`) into shared files and edits both call sites.

summary: The prior round's family-packaging finding is resolved (isArithFrobAt_apply_sqrt now takes a single {x : K} {d : ℤ}). Remaining: the [Q.IsPrime] instance argument is unused in the four square-root lemmas — the sign separation is carried by IsDomain S, not by primality of Q — and the Galois-action compatibility block is proved inline twice.
